subject: maths
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 40, 60 and 120 days, respectively. In how many days can A do the work if he is assisted by B and C on every third day?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 40 days

B can do the work in 60 days

C can do the work in 120 days

**Formula used:**

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ 1/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of A is 1/40

The efficiency of B is 1/60

The efficiency of C is 1/120

1st day work by A = 1/40

2ⁿd day work by A = 1/60

3rd day work by A + B + C = 1/40 + 1/60 + 1/120

⇒ (3 + 2 + 1)/120 = 1/20

Work completed in 3 days

⇒ 1/40 + 1/40 + 1/20 = 1/10

Time taken to complete the work

⇒ 3 × 10 = 30 days

**∴ In 30 days the work will be completed.**
